standard.title: Temephos, Technical — Specification (टेमीफॉस, तकनीकी — विशिष्टि) (Second Revision)
standard.sector: Food and Agriculture / Pesticides and Pesticide Residues

sectional_committee.name: Pesticides and Pesticides Residues Analysis Sectional Committee

standard.description: This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for temephos, technical, which is used as an active ingredient in the formulation of public health and agricultural insecticides.
standard.scope: This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for temephos, technical, which is used as an active ingredient in the formulation of public health and agricultural insecticides.

revision_history: First Edition / First Revision, Prior to 2013

amendments.summary: No active amendments have been issued on this standard (NIL on this copy).

certification.description: Voluntary/Mandatory under the Insecticides Act. Manufacturers are encouraged to apply for the prestigious BIS 'Standard Mark' (ISI Mark) to print on product containers as a certified assurance of quality. Additionally, all packaging, labeling, and distribution of technical-grade temephos must strictly comply with statutory registrations and warning declarations mandated under the Insecticides Act, 1968 and Rules framed thereunder.
requirements: Mandates that the temephos content shall be a minimum of 90.0 percent by mass, determined by High Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) equipped with a UV-VIS detector.
Restricts moisture content to a maximum of 0.2 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 4.1.
Restricts free acidity (calculated as H2SO4) to a maximum of 0.3 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 11.3.2.
Limits material insoluble in acetone to a maximum of 0.5 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 9.
Technical temephos must be securely packed in containers satisfying the general requirements of IS 8190 (Part 2) for liquid technical pesticides.

Each container must legibly and indelibly bear: the name of the material, manufacturer's name and address, batch number, date of manufacture, date of expiry, net quantity, nominal temephos content (percent m/m), and standard cautionary notices worded in accordance with the Insecticides Act, 1968.

Requires weighing exactly 0.033 3 g of reference standard temephos of known purity into a 50 ml volumetric flask, adding 5 ml of internal standard solution, and making up to the mark with mobile phase.

Requires weighing a sample quantity equivalent to contain 0.033 3 g of temephos into a 50 ml volumetric flask, adding 5 ml of internal standard solution, making up to the mark with mobile phase, and shaking well to homogenize.

Injects a 10 µl aliquot. Computes the percentage of temephos content by mass using peak areas of temephos and the internal standard:
Temephos content, % by mass = (M1 * A2 * A3 * P) / (M2 * A1 * A4)
where M1 is mass of reference standard (g), M2 is mass of sample (g), A1 & A2 are peak areas of temephos in standard & sample, A3 & A4 are peak areas of internal standard in standard & sample, and P is standard purity.

Any observed or calculated test or analysis value expressing purity, moisture, acidity, or insolubles must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be identical to the specified value in the standard.
